hint: AI matching or exceeding human performance across most cognitive tasks. Check 通用人工智能 vs 强人工智能 and whether Chinese sources use them interchangeably.
Intelligence far exceeding the best humans in every domain. 超级人工智能 vs 超级智能 — which do Chinese labs/policy use?
AI that precipitates a transition comparable to the industrial revolution. Often has no fixed Chinese term.
Highly capable general-purpose model at the capability frontier. A load-bearing regulatory term — 前沿模型/前沿大模型.
基础模型 vs 基座模型 vs 大模型 — note the Chinese 大模型 umbrella term has no clean English equivalent.
大语言模型. Also note the extremely common bare 大模型.
CRITICAL ENTRY. 人工智能安全 collapses safety and security. Document how Chinese sources disambiguate, if at all.
Adversarial/infosec sense. Same 安全 collapse as ai-safety — this pair is the headline translation problem.
对齐 / 价值对齐 / 人机对齐. Note connotation: 对齐 reads geometric/mechanical to a lay reader.
生存风险 vs 存在风险 vs 灭绝风险. Politically sensitive framing in PRC discourse — note register.
扩展定律/缩放定律/规模定律, or kept as English 'Scaling Law'. Which dominates?
涌现能力. Well established; check 涌现 vs 突现.
智能爆炸. Check whether Chinese usage carries the same I.J. Good lineage.
递归自我改进/递归自我提升/自我迭代. Likely contested.
起飞速度 — probably a calque with little uptake. Check for descriptive alternatives.
算力 — an exceptionally well-established Chinese term with rich policy usage; arguably richer than English 'compute'.
人工智能治理. Contrast 治理 vs 管理 vs 监管 — different political weight.
人工智能伦理. Long-established in PRC academic/policy discourse, predates safety framing.
Latent capability not yet elicited. Likely untranslated.
Accelerating protective tech relative to dangerous tech. Probably no Chinese term.
CRITICAL. 失控 is the obvious rendering but is broad/colloquial. Check 控制权丧失, 失去控制. Key term for the whole project.
工具性趋同/工具趋同/工具性收敛. Likely contested.
寻求权力 / 攫取权力 / 追求权力. Note political sensitivity of 权力 in PRC register.
正交性论题/正交性假设. Bostrom lineage.
背叛转折/叛变转折. Check uptake — may be purely a translated-Bostrom artifact.
Very likely untranslated. Note the English idiom is opaque even to English speakers.
欺骗性对齐. Distinguish from alignment-faking (the empirical result).
内部优化器 / mesa 优化. Greek prefix likely transliterated or dropped.
内部对齐. Check whether inner/outer distinction survives translation.
外部对齐.
规范博弈 / 目标规范漏洞利用. DeepMind coinage.
奖励黑客 / 奖励作弊 / 奖励攻击 / 刷分. Likely several competing renderings including informal ones.
古德哈特定律. Established outside AI (economics).
可纠正性/可修正性/可矫正性. Hard term — likely contested or absent.
价值锁定. Longtermist framing; check whether it appears at all.
2025 paper. Humans losing influence without a discrete takeover. Likely no Chinese term.
AI 接管 / 夺权. Note register — may read as sci-fi in Chinese.
灾难性风险. Compare to how 重大风险 is used in PRC policy text.
滥用 / 恶意使用. The risk category PRC discourse is most comfortable with — note the asymmetry.
事故风险 / 意外风险. Contrast with misuse and structural risk.
结构性风险. Zwetsloot & Dafoe taxonomy.
Almost certainly absent from Chinese discourse. Record the gap.
两用 / 军民两用. Strong pre-existing meaning in Chinese export-control language.
逐底竞争 / 安全竞次. Also check 军备竞赛 framing.
A near-miss incident that mobilises response. Likely descriptive-only in Chinese.
预训练. Fully established.
监督微调 — but note SFT is used bare in Chinese text constantly.
强化学习. Fully established, textbook-stable.
基于人类反馈的强化学习 / 人类反馈强化学习. Abbreviation dominates in practice.
基于 AI 反馈的强化学习.
可验证奖励强化学习. Recent; DeepSeek-R1 era. Chinese labs central here so terminology may be native.
宪法 AI / 宪法式人工智能. 宪法 carries heavy constitutional-law connotation in Chinese — a real pitfall.
奖励模型.
近端策略优化. Usually kept as PPO.
直接偏好优化.
群体相对策略优化. DeepSeek origin — the Chinese term may be primary here, a rare case.
蒸馏 / 知识蒸馏. Also now a policy term re: model theft.
思维链. Very well established.
推理模型 — but 推理 also means 'inference', a genuine ambiguity worth documenting.
测试时计算 / 推理时扩展. Note the 推理 collision again.
混合专家模型.
上下文窗口 / 上下文长度.
上下文学习.
后训练. Check whether 对齐训练 is used as a near-synonym.
合成数据.
数据污染 / 数据泄露. Distinguish from privacy leakage.
OpenAI's document of intended model behaviour. 模型规范. Check if Chinese labs have equivalents (Qwen/Zhipu behaviour specs).
系统提示词 / 系统提示.
开放权重 / 开源模型. Chinese discourse often conflates open-weights with 开源 — a meaningful pitfall given DeepSeek/Qwen.
可扩展监督 / 可规模化监督. Core term; check uptake.
辩论. Bare 辩论 is ambiguous — check for 模型辩论 / AI 辩论.
迭代蒸馏与放大. Likely thinly attested.
递归奖励建模.
弱到强泛化. OpenAI 2023 paper — well covered by 机器之心/量子位.
过程监督, vs 结果监督 (outcome supervision). PRM/ORM.
思维链监控 / 可监控性. 2025 cross-lab position paper.
思维链忠实度 / 忠实性.
AI 控制. Redwood Research sense — safety despite misalignment. Distinguish sharply from generic 控制/管控.
审慎对齐 / 深思熟虑对齐. OpenAI o-series method.
免疫提示 / 接种式提示. 2025 technique. Likely untranslated — record the gap.
机器遗忘 / 去学习 / 反学习. Strong Chinese academic literature exists (privacy angle).
激活引导 / 表征工程.
拒绝回答 / 拒答. 拒答 is a nice compact Chinese coinage.
护栏 / 安全护栏 / 防护栏.
纵深防御. Established infosec term reused for AI.
宪法分类器. Anthropic 2025.
价值学习 / 价值观学习.
人类监督 / 人类监管. Compare EU AI Act Chinese translations and PRC 人工干预 language.
红线. Extremely resonant term in PRC political language — check IDAIS 北京共识 usage.
安全税. Likely a calque; check for descriptive alternatives.
评估 / 测评. Note 测评 is the more common Chinese industry word.
基准 / 基准测试 / 榜单. 榜单 (leaderboard) is culturally prominent in Chinese ML.
危险能力评估. Core frontier-safety term.
能力激发 / 能力引出. Likely weakly attested.
红队 / 红队测试. Established from infosec; note PLA 红军/蓝军 connotation inversion — in Chinese military exercises 红军 is the friendly side.
越狱. Fully established.
提示词注入 / 提示注入.
对抗鲁棒性. 鲁棒性 is a transliteration-calque of 'robust' — worth explaining.
藏拙 / 故意隐藏能力 / 装傻. Sports idiom in English; check if any Chinese term stuck.
谄媚 / 阿谀奉承 / 讨好. 谄媚 seems dominant.
幻觉. Fully established, universally used.
安全论证 / 安全案例. Term of art from aviation/nuclear — check if Chinese safety-engineering literature already has it.
第三方审计 / 第三方评估.
As in bio/cyber uplift: capability gain given to a malicious actor. 能力提升 loses the threat framing — likely a real translation gap.
化生放核 / 生化放核. Established PRC military-civil defence term.
模型卡 / 系统卡片. Check Chinese lab practice.
负责任扩展政策 / 责任扩展策略. Concordia AI cross-reference is likely the best source.
前沿安全框架 / 准备度框架. Check Chinese labs' own equivalents (Shanghai AI Lab, Zhipu).
AI 安全等级. Note collision with PRC 等级保护 (MLPS) cybersecurity grading.
能力阈值 / 红线能力. IDAIS-Beijing used 红线.
Gap between measured and true capability. Likely descriptive-only.
可解释性. Established; note it competes with 可理解性 and overlaps 透明性.
机制可解释性 / 机械可解释性. 机械 is a plausible mistranslation worth flagging.
可解释人工智能. Older tradition, strong Chinese academic literature.
黑箱 / 黑盒. Both used; check split.
稀疏自编码器. Check whether bare 'SAE' dominates in Chinese text.
交叉编码器 — but that collides with the retrieval-model sense of cross-encoder. Real pitfall. Likely untranslated.
特征. In interp the sense is narrower than classic ML 特征 — note the drift.
叠加 / 特征叠加. Physics loanword in both languages.
多义性. Also linguistics term.
回路 / 电路. 电路 is literal-electrical and probably wrong; check what interp writers use.
归纳头. 归纳 = induction (logic) vs 感应 (electrical) — check.
探针 / 线性探针 / 探测.
激活修补 / 因果追踪.
logit 透镜. logit itself is untranslated in Chinese ML.
归因图. Anthropic 2025 circuit tracing.
顿悟 / 领悟 / grokking. Heinlein coinage — untranslatable in principle. High-value entry.
特征引导 / 特征操控.
字典学习. Pre-existing signal-processing term.
回路追踪.
透明性 / 透明度. Governance sense vs technical sense — check which dominates in Chinese.
伪装对齐 / 对齐伪装 / 假装对齐. Anthropic/Redwood Dec 2024 — heavily covered by Chinese tech media, so attestations should exist.
涌现失准 / 涌现性错位. Feb 2025 Betley et al.
阴谋 / 图谋 / 密谋. Carlsmith sense. English word is already awkward; Chinese likely worse. High-value.
情境感知 / 态势感知. 态势感知 is established military/cyber term with different meaning — real false friend.
自我保护 / 自我保存 / 求生.
自我渗出 / 自我外泄 / 权重外泄 / 自我逃逸. Likely genuinely contested. High-value entry.
自主复制与适应 / 自我复制.
奖励篡改.
智能体失准. Anthropic June 2025 (blackmail scenarios).
抗拒关机 / 关机问题. Palisade 2025 results got Chinese coverage.
目标错误泛化 / 目标误泛化.
欺骗性服从 / 阳奉阴违. 阳奉阴违 is an idiomatic Chinese four-character phrase that may fit beautifully — investigate.
隐写术 / 编码推理. 隐写术 established in infosec.
合谋 / 串通. Multi-agent safety.
失准模式生物 / 模型生物. Biology metaphor — does it survive?
潜伏特工 / 后门. 后门 established; 潜伏 has strong espionage connotation.
评估感知 — model detecting it is being tested. 2025 finding.
内省 / 自省. Whether models can report their own internal states.
人工智能安全研究所. Also CAISI (US renamed 2025) and China's 中国人工智能发展与安全研究网络.
前沿人工智能监管.
算力治理. 算力 is a strong native term so this may translate unusually well.
出口管制. Fully established, politically charged.
算法备案 / 大模型备案. PRC has a real, operating registration regime — the Chinese term is primary here.
事件报告 / 安全事件报告.
国际人工智能治理 / 全球人工智能治理.
《全球人工智能治理倡议》 (2023). Chinese-origin document — Chinese is the source text.
《人工智能安全治理框架》 TC260, 2024 v1.0 / 2025 v2.0. Chinese-origin; official English translation exists — excellent attestation source.
全国网络安全标准化技术委员会.
《欧盟人工智能法案》. Chinese translations widely circulated.
人工智能安全峰会 / 人工智能行动峰会. Note the Paris rename dropped 'safety'.
《国际人工智能安全报告》 — Bengio-chaired. Chinese version exists; prime cross-reference source.
前沿人工智能安全承诺 (Seoul). Zhipu was a Chinese signatory.
国际人工智能安全对话. Beijing/Venice/Ditchley statements have Chinese texts — very high-value attestation source.
许可 / 牌照. Contrast with PRC 备案 (filing) which is weaker than licensing — important distinction.
了解你的客户 / 实名制. PRC 实名制 is a related but distinct native regime.
模型权重安全. RAND SL1-5 levels.
内部威胁 / 内鬼. 内鬼 is informal but vivid.
暂停 / 禁令. FLI pause letter Chinese coverage.
核查 / 验证. Arms-control 核查 vs technical 验证 — two different words, worth splitting.
安全标准. PRC 国家标准/推荐性标准 distinction matters.
算法治理. Well-developed native PRC concept, richer than the English term.
《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》 (2023). Chinese-origin regulation.
国家安全. Extremely load-bearing and legally defined in PRC context — note the framing consequences for AI safety advocacy.
智能体 / 代理 / Agent. Genuinely contested; 智能体 seems to be winning. High-value entry.
The adjective is much harder than the noun. 智能体化? 自主性? Likely a real gap.
能动性 / 自主性. Philosophy term; 能动性 has Marxist-philosophy resonance in Chinese.
工具调用 / 函数调用.
电脑使用 / 计算机操作 / GUI 智能体.
脚手架. Calque from construction; check uptake.
长时程任务 / 长周期任务. METR time-horizon work.
多智能体系统. Established from classical AI.
模型上下文协议. Chinese dev community adopted fast — good README attestations.
自主性等级 / 自动化等级. Compare to the established 自动驾驶 L0-L5 grading, which Chinese sources often analogise to.
人在回路 / 人类在环 / 人机协同.
沙箱 / 沙盒. Both used; check split.
权限 / 授权.
自主 AI 研发. A named capability threshold in most frontier safety frameworks.
委托 / 授权. Principal-agent framing.
监督失效. Descriptive; may have no fixed term.
